title: About
seoDescription: About Schnurr Painting and its commercial painting approach.

hero.title: More than painters. A partner in every phase.
hero.intro: Commercial painting built around execution, accountability, and long-term relationships.

sections.title: Commercial painting is a coordination business.
sections.copy: The finished surface matters, but so do schedule, communication, occupied-space planning, safety, and the ability to close the work cleanly.

sections.title: Built around accountable crews.
sections.copy: Schnurr Painting brings experienced field teams and project leadership together so commercial work moves with fewer loose ends.

sections.title: Long-term relationships over one-off jobs.
sections.copy: The goal is repeatable performance for general contractors, owners, and project teams that need a painting partner they can rely on.
